name: Pensioner Education Supplement
summary: A fortnightly top-up for people on certain pensions and parenting payments who study at least a quarter of a full-time load.
who: People getting Carer Payment, Disability Support Pension or Parenting Payment Single, plus some other payments in specific cases.
Studying at least 25% of a full-time load.
Australian residents aged 16 or over. There is no upper age limit.
how: You need to lodge a claim with Services Australia before it can be paid.
catches: Not paid with Youth Allowance or Austudy.
It is not taxable and has no income or assets test.
The guide gives a rate but was last reviewed in January 2022, so no amount is shown until we confirm it.
